data.summary: Functional Business Analyst with 9 plus years of experience in the banking domain, specializing in functional requirement analysis, system enhancements, and process re-engineering. Skilled in gathering and translating business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and workflows. Extensive experience supporting core banking operations, digital channels, payments, lending, and regulatory compliance initiatives. Adept at coordinating with business stakeholders, technology teams, and QA to ensure smooth end- to-end delivery in Agile and Waterfall environments.

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst
Capgemini (SMBC Project)
11/2024 – 02/2026
Gathered requirements and performed data analysis to prepare BRD and FSD/FRD documents.
Automated regulatory and internal reports using PBI enhancing reporting efficiency and accuracy.
Led the migration of Treasury & Risk management from Qlik Sense to PBI, improving data visualization capabilities.
Collaborated with developers, QAs, and RTB in Agile environments to refine requirements and secure stakeholder sign-off.
Facilitated client calls to resolve discrepancies and capture detailed requirements, ensuring alignment and Stakeholder Management. • Led a cross-functional team/ Project Lead to achieve project goals and milestones.
Validated UAT results post-code changes, coordinated reviews with RTB, and secured stakeholder approvals for production releases.
Business Analyst
Accenture (ENBD Project)
06/2023 - 09/2024
Requirement Gathering, Data Analysis, Preparation of BRD and FSD/FRD. • Creating a JIRA for each test case along with Visio flow charts. • Explain the Requirements to SQL Developers & help them in case of any understanding gap and provide reference data/ Source data.
Handle the queries raised by Devs/QA/RTB and any other. • Working closely with the On-shore Stakeholders to understand the Project Workflow and its High Priority tasks and delivering within the due date.
Working in Agile Environment, Creating User Stories in JIRA/Confluence.
Business Analyst
JoulestoWatts (Barclays Project)
03/2022 - 12/2022
Analysis of Business requirement documents (BRD) sent by the clients across global and understand the requirements
Listen to the User stories and understand the requirement • Explain to the SQL and JAVA developers about the Sprint/Iterations • Co-Ordinate with Scrum Master and the Product Owners • Test the UAT Results and get the Sign off from the Consumers • Schedule a call with the clients to discuss the requirements in detail for better clarification if any discrepancies
Business Analyst
HSBC - Electronic Data Processing
11/2018 - 03/2022
A leading international bank providing financial services and products
Requirement Gathering, Data Analysis, Preparation of BRD and FSD • Supported due diligence, portfolio monitoring, and performance improvement across private equity and private credit investments. Focused on EBITDA growth, cash flow stability, and risk management to drive value and protect capital.

Co-ordinating with developers to ensure qualitative deliverable within target deadline
• Tools used such as JIRA and Share point for Project Management • Major Project - SFTR, BREXIT, MIFID, HKMA phase 2 implementations • Client Interaction, UAT Testing, Meeting deadlines on Time and GO LIVE
EXPERIENCE

Gallagher service Centre LLP
03/2017 - 09/2018
Execute and evaluate manual or automated test cases and report test results
Ensure that validated deliverables meet functional and design specifications and requirements
Prepare Reconciliation reports by matching GL Account Reports and Production Reports with Balance Sheet every week and share with Reporting Officer and Branch heads in US
Performing root cause analyses on identified risk events to recommend improvements to prevent these risk events from re-occurring in future

EXL (OPI) Financial Services Pvt Ltd (KPMG Dallas)
10/2015 - 09/2016
Responsible for Cash Posting, Refunds, Bill Maintenance, Write-off Bad debts, Journal Entry, Move Funds & Dummy Cash Processing
Monitor customer account details for non-payments, delayed payments and other irregularities
Responsible for Handling U.S DASC (DALAS Accounting)/ Settlement Country Activity, GL and reconcile in the Ledger books.
Communicate with CSR's & branch heads through email for clarifications & resolutions
Handle multiple locations and meet the client's SLA and TAT • Process credit card payments and assist with month-end closing
